summaries.name: Section 8
summaries.summary: Section 8 is a government-subsidized housing assistance program suggested as an affordable housing option for the user's apartment search, as of 2023-05-21. The user is not eligible for government assistance programs like Section 8.

summaries.name: HotPads
summaries.summary: HotPads is a map-based rental search site with filters for price, location, and amenities. It offers a "Commute Time" feature showing travel time to specific locations like a volunteer job. The user has already been using HotPads in their apartment search as of 2023-05-21.

summaries.name: Walk Score
summaries.summary: Walk Score is a resource (not exclusively a rental search site) that evaluates the walkability and public transportation access of a neighborhood, giving a score based on proximity to amenities and public transportation when an address or neighborhood is entered.

summaries.name: Apartments.com
summaries.summary: Apartments.com is a comprehensive rental search site with filters for price, location, and amenities, and a "Ratings & Reviews" feature showing feedback from current and former residents.

summaries.name: Rent Jungle
summaries.summary: Rent Jungle is a rental search engine that aggregates listings from various sources, with filters for price, location, and amenities, and a "Neighborhood Guide" feature providing local area insights.

summaries.name: Facebook Marketplace
summaries.summary: Facebook Marketplace is recommended, along with Craigslist, as a local online classified site that may have affordable room rental options.
